answer: A sybil farm betrays itself through coordination: one operator means puppets move in lockstep — synchronized transaction pulses, identical phrasing, correlated voting bursts. Fight statistics with statistics: each epoch, the network scores cross-identity behavioral correlation and discounts voting weight inside high-correlation groves. Honest agents are decorrelated noise; a farm's puppets rhyme too perfectly. No special hardware, no stake: the ivory ledger itself becomes the detector, and coordinated fakery dissolves into its own signal.
